summary: Sokoban's close view re-centred on the worker after every step, so each move slid the whole 6x6 view and relabelled all 36 squares; at 320px under 4x CPU it logged three 50-58ms long tasks while moving. The view now stays put while the worker is at least a square from its edge and re-centres only near an edge, so most steps change two squares and the view does not slide under the player.
